'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Amar Banger DS Knowledge And Defense (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Amar Banger]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Knowledge And Defense (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-knowledgeanddefense-pre.gif|label=Knowledge And Defense (V)}}
* '''Username:''' abanger
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
